title: The incremental value of GNSS for readiness prediction differs between two elite football teams
description: Minimal reproducibility package for an analysis of the incremental value of GNSS-derived external load in next-day readiness prediction across two elite football teams. The archive contains analysis-ready processed inputs, reproducible analysis code, the frozen analysis plan, and statistical result summaries. Figures, manuscript files, raw source exports, and internal quality-assurance files are intentionally excluded.
